projects.title: Brain tumor MRI classifier
projects.description: A deep learning model in PyTorch that classifies MRI scans into tumor types, with OpenCV preprocessing and a confusion-matrix report for medical diagnosis support.

projects.title: Campus event portal
projects.description: A React web app with Firebase authentication where clubs post events and students register. Includes a calendar view and email reminders.

projects.title: Smart hostel energy monitor
projects.description: An ESP32 and Arduino IoT system with current sensors that tracks electricity use per room and sends alerts to a dashboard.

projects.title: Library book tracker
projects.description: A Flask and SQL web application with Docker deployment for issuing, returning and searching library books.

projects.title: Syllabus Q&A chatbot
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented generation chatbot using a large language model and FastAPI that answers student questions from course syllabus PDFs.

projects.title: Chest X-ray pneumonia detector
projects.description: A PyTorch convolutional neural network that detects pneumonia from chest X-ray images, with data augmentation and explainability heatmaps for health diagnosis.
